_doc: channel: max per-channel delta (0-255) for a pixel to count as equal; maxRatio: max fraction of differing pixels. Never loosen to make a run pass; look at out/<name>.diff.png first.
_hold_doc: hold: regexes of shots reviewed but not yet approved (reported VISUAL HOLD). Empty since trace TR1-TR5 merged. verdi-notice stays a harness limit (modal refused in tests, SKIP).

nameMasks._doc: Applied only when the shots were taken on a format other than fsdb (out*/.format, written by shot.cjs): the dump's file name shows in the title bar and editor tabs, and in the dbg-break call stack. One baseline set (from FSDB) serves every format, so any other pixel change still fails. Rects are inclusive pixel boxes {x0,y0,x1,y1}.
